consular.mission: Australian Consulate, Tegucigalpa; Australian Embassy, Mexico City
consular.notes: Australia has a consulate in Tegucigalpa, headed by an Honorary Consul. The consulate provides limited consular assistance to Australians in Honduras. The Consulate can conduct passport interviews and provide provisional travel documents for emergency travel to the nearest Australian embassy. The Consulate can’t issue Australian passports.
